focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Scores to Decisions: Reading Classification Models Carefully
utility_title: CSV Numeric Summary and Bootstrap Mean Interval
utility_use_case: A researcher receives a CSV of repeated sensor readings and wants a quick, reproducible first-pass summary before making a visualization. Running `bash csv-statistics.sh --file measurements.csv --column value --seed 42` produces JSON with the sample size, missing and invalid counts, central summaries, spread, and a bootstrap mean interval. The researcher can preserve the command and JSON with the analysis, inspect data-quality counts, and decide whether the sampling design supports ordinary row-wise resampling. The interval is descriptive, not a causal or significance claim.

glossary_edits.definition: In score-based binary classification analysis, the maximum absolute separation between cumulative distributions of positive and negative cases. It summarizes ranking separation, but does not alone establish future stability or generalization.
The harmonic mean of precision and recall, $2PR/(P+R)$. It combines those two measures into one value but does not explicitly encode class prevalence or the relative costs of error types.
